subtitle: An italic subtitle for a post
---

A post with a footnote.[^source] The same source can be cited again.[^source]

Inline math also works in posts: \(E = mc^2\).

[^source]: A reference with *emphasis* and a [link](https://example.com/).

    A second paragraph in the same note.
